explanation: This policy governs what advice to foreground, not mission availability. Chapter 2 rule truth stays in chapter_02_graph_v0_1.json.

prompt_receipts_schema.displayed_prompt_keys: array of event IDs; no gameplay evidence
prompt_receipts_schema.displayed_alert_keys: array of alert IDs; no game evidence
prompt_receipts_schema.note: Ephemeral fixture-only de-duplication. Receipts are not mission completion, acquisition, save history or cross-thread persistence.

activation_policy.fresh_detection: compare explicit prior scenario vs current; unknown-to-eligible becomes newly eligible only within those fixtures
activation_policy.no_prior_scenario: present compatible current reference as contextual, never claim a newly unlocked system
activation_policy.shown_once: after an optional event is presented in a synthetic sequence, suppress repetition unless explicitly requested
activation_policy.dormant_reactivated_alert: newly activated evidence may re-promote existing alert, even when already displayed earlier
activation_policy.active_critical: remain pinned while active; after first prompt show pinned-only unless a risky advance is explicitly requested
activation_policy.chapter_exit: immediately prioritize before-advance check, but never assume optional content exists
activation_policy.milestone_change: project recommendations evolve only with explicit source-backed gate/observation change; receipts do not update project stage
activation_policy.no_cooldown_seconds: No time-based random windows or fabricated in-game timer
activation_policy.event_specific_outing: Use a source-linked opportunity corresponding to the introduced system; do not reuse an unrelated featured project outing for a Fence/Fishing introduction.

suppression_rules: Priority alert when activated wagon job exists; no optional outing until task dealt with
At chapter exit, only targeted conditional preservation audit; exclude stale introductory window
When story control chained or unknown, don't promise a valid free-roam outing
No recurring introduction just because a capability remains available
Disputed prerequisites cannot cause automatic new marker availability
Only explicitly observed in fixture may be called observed
Without previous scenario, never label system INTRODUCED_TODAY
